# mxroute_forwarders (Data Source)

List forwarders and unordered destination sets for an owned domain. Collection completeness remains live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_forwarders" "routes" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Owned canonical domain.

### Read-Only

- `forwarders` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forwarders))

Read-Only:
